## Context / immutable basis
Exactly 18 bloated leading module docstrings (3,187 base words) are confirmed across 18 paths. Condense repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, and obsolete change history while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

Before-citations use `origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`. A path-scoped comparison through `88c90f8b5abf4a80be3b1289d7719d6e03e29684` found zero overlap. Implement from current `origin/main`, retain `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84` as the immutable before-image, and keep this leaf to one commit so path checks use `HEAD^..HEAD`.

## Boundary and immutable oracle
Below, `M` means `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate`. Each editable ID is exactly `D:module`, the leading module string docstring in that path. Edit no other block. Every module docstring must shrink and state current rationale/constraints; preserve cited literals and behavioral oracles.

Parse base/final source with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`; replace only the 18 allowlisted module-docstring values; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require exact attribute-free AST equality. Tokenize independently to preserve directive/shebang text and inline/next-statement attachment. Runtime strings, inline comments, unlisted prose, executable syntax, and zero-context diff hunks outside the base spans remain exact.

## Scope — 18 editable blocks
- `M/_coordinator_harness.py` — `D:module`; preserve both importing suites, shared frozen-clock/script/binding/verified-fake seams, namespace loading, and zero I/O/sleep.
- `M/test_acli_cross_mixin_binding.py` — `D:module`; preserve real MRO cross-mixin resolution and coverage of the eight otherwise-unreferenced graph methods through subprocess/REST seams.
- `M/test_adf_soft_wrap.py` — `D:module`; preserve soft-line joining, blank-paragraph separation, structural lines, and idempotent text↔ADF behavior.
- `M/test_apply_batch_drift_tolerance.py` — `D:module`; preserve benign subject classification, real advancing ticket-branch commits, refreshed pins, and loud competing-pass drift.
- `M/test_apply_list_of_mutations.py` — `D:module`; preserve typed-to-dict batch conversion, expected/JSON-safe fields, empty fields, and fail-closed inbound routing.
- `M/test_apply_outbound_create_rollback.py` — `D:module`; preserve the legacy-selector-only delete rollback, retry seam, original exception, coordinated default, and no success rollback.
- `M/test_assignee_validation.py` — `D:module`; preserve prevalidation before ACLI, exact/normalized identity acceptance, fuzzy rejection, and issue/project scope.
- `M/test_comment_enrichment.py` — `D:module`; preserve one paged enrichment, snapshot dedup, per-ticket fallback for omission/failure, warning, and no live Jira.
- `M/test_coordinator_route_census.py` — `D:module`; preserve single typed ownership, provider-neutral unknown-action failure before effects, removed fallbacks, no remote delete, and explicit protocol fakes.
- `M/test_coordinator_venue_cutover.py` — `D:module`; preserve the real coordinator chain over Cloud/DC verified fakes, one physical summary update, venue wire shapes, parity, and five-bucket tallies.
- `M/test_create_containment.py` — `D:module`; preserve record-key→label→optional-property→confirm order, retained keys/no delete on failure, pure injected seams, and dependent evidence.
- `M/test_create_coordinator.py` — `D:module`; preserve pending-before-create, exactly one create, ambiguous re-observation, recover/defer without blind replay/delete, and pure decision logic.
- `M/test_create_live_cutover_heldout.py` — `D:module`; preserve the real batch/handler selector path, binding/outcome/deferred evidence, one create on both routes, and byte-stable legacy rollback.
- `M/test_create_operation_coordinator.py` — `D:module`; preserve the single route selector, full create/containment composition, dependent gate, crash-restart one-create/one-binding convergence, and keyed no-search recovery.
- `M/test_creation_channel_jira.py` — `D:module`; preserve validated Jira genesis on tickets/identities, no outbound rewrite, and exact three-signal legacy inference.
- `M/test_dc_outbound_comment_length_convergence.py` — `D:module`; preserve two-pass DC comment convergence, direct sanitizer injection, marker-safe fitting, and recorder-based proof of the DC path.
- `M/test_dc_outbound_description_length_convergence.py` — `D:module`; preserve two-pass DC description convergence, all-three backend injections, plain-character limit, and value-based DC-path proof.
- `M/test_dc_summary_executor.py` — `D:module`; preserve max_retries=0 construction, one GET→PUT→GET, separate ambiguous observation, replay-budget decisions, no SDK sleep/replay, and redacted bounded terminal log.

## Protected exclusions and consumers
All 308 other owner-docstring/full-line-comment blocks are excluded. Concise examples include `test_drift_tolerates_suggestion_record` (7 words), `test_fetcher_enriches_comment_field` (7), and `run` (8). Longer helper/per-test explanations—frozen clocks, stateful fakes, retry/containment order, literal DC ceilings, venue parity, and real-library retry-disable evidence—are load-bearing and remain exact. Preserve 22 directive tokens/attachments: 16 type-ignore tokens and 6 no-cover pragmas.

Pytest collects every test module; `_coordinator_harness.py` is imported by two coordinator suites. `test_coordinator_route_census.py` inspects production `create_coordinator.__doc__`, not its editable module docstring; the production string remains AST-identical. `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py` is the prose-policy consumer. No targeted consumer of an editable docstring was found.

## Independent review receipt
A reviewer who did not author the prose change must post exactly 18 leaf-linked TSV rows:
`path<TAB>block-id<TAB>before-full-SHA:lines<TAB>final-full-SHA:lines<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>directives-exact<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session`

Before citations use `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`; final citations use the full final SHA. Every after count is lower and all three verdict columns are `PASS`. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 18 allowlisted module-docstring blocks change.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and current.
- [ ] Normalized AST dumps equal the immutable before-image.
- [ ] Runtime strings remain AST-identical.
- [ ] Directive/shebang text and attachment remain exact.
- [ ] `HEAD^..HEAD` changes exactly all 18 file-impact paths.
- [ ] Focused pytest passes every impacted module.
- [ ] Scoped Ruff check and format verification pass.
- [ ] Repository comment hygiene passes.
- [ ] The path-scoped diff has no whitespace errors.
- [ ] Worktree-venv `make verify` passes without a timeout.
- [ ] The non-author TSV contains exactly 18 valid `PASS` rows.

## Verification
Run all seven structured DD commands: `immutable-prose-only`, `exact-leaf-paths`, `focused-tests`, `scoped-ruff`, `comment-hygiene`, `diff-integrity`, and `repository-gates`.
